thread:
Jordan: Kickoff — Windlass week0 private/VPC onboarding. Quick health check for networking, IAM, KMS, and audit logs. Any blockers?

Priya (CS Ops): Network pieces mostly done from our side. Spoke-to-hub peering established, subnets created. Waiting on Windlass to confirm firewall ACLs for outbound to our endpoints.

Alex (NetEng): Need them to allow outbound 443 to api.redwood-inference.com + 443/8443 to S3 endpoints for telemetry ingestion. Also recommend a NAT gateway in the public subnet for egress.

Jordan: Noted. Do we have a specific list of IPs/endpoints we should share? I can drop into the runbook.

Alex (NetEng): Yes — sending short list: api.redwood-inference.com (A -> 3.121.45.10, 3.121.45.11), telemetry-s3 (s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com). Will paste into runbook.

Priya (CS Ops): On IAM: customer is using their own cross-account role. They reported sts:AssumeRole failing with AccessDenied. Can someone confirm the trust policy requirements we gave?

Sam (Security): Saw that — their trust policy was missing the external ID and didn't include our service role ARN. Quick fix is to add:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"windlass-external-id-xyz"}}}]}
```
I'll DM the exact snippet to their infra lead.

Priya (CS Ops): KMS — they brought their own CMK. Their key policy currently denies Decrypt for external principals. We hit a kms:Decrypt error during model boot.

Sam (Security): Yep. We need kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey granted to our cross-account role. Sample policy to include in the key policy:
```json
{"Sid":"AllowRedwood","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference"]},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
```
(we'll tailor ARN to their key).

Jordan: I'll push both the IAM trust and KMS policy snippets into the runbook and ping Windlass. Priya — can you own the runbook update?

Priya (CS Ops): On it. Adding entries under: /runbooks/windlass/week0 (Network -> firewall IPs, IAM -> trust policy, KMS -> key snippet, Telemetry -> HEC URL).

OpsBot: Audit logs forwarding attempt to their Splunk HEC failed: TLS handshake error (cert CN mismatch). Ticket created: OPS-7891.

Alex (NetEng): For telemetry we recommended using our proxy relay if customers can't present a trusted cert. Alternative: we can accept logs via presigned S3 with server-side encryption. Which route does Windlass prefer?

Jordan: Windlass asked for Splunk HEC. They will rotate certs tomorrow and retest. Priya — add fallback to presigned S3 in runbook.

Priya (CS Ops): Fallback noted. Also flagged retention: Windlass requested audit log retention 365d (they're regulated). Currently our default retention on their workspace is 90d. Need ops approval to extend. This is a potential renewal risk if not completed before cutover.

Sam (Security): I'll escalate retention change to infra. We need to confirm storage cost impact, but compliance takes precedence.

Jordan: Action items recap: 1) Priya update runbook + send KMS/IAM snippets to Windlass (owner: Priya). 2) Alex confirm firewall IP list and recommended NAT/GW configuration (owner: Alex). 3) Sam escalate KMS policy & retention change, confirm cost delta (owner: Sam). 4) Jordan schedule Thursday 10am PT touch with Windlass infra for live validation.

Priya (CS Ops): Done — runbook updated and snippets posted. DM sent to their infra.

Alex (NetEng): Firewall IP list posted in runbook. NAT recommendation added.

Sam (Security): KMS policy change requested with their security team. Retention change ticket OPS-7892 opened and linked to OPS-7891.

Jordan: Thanks all. Marking this thread as the week0 health check. I'll capture renewal-watch note: "Requires retention extension before cutover or flagged as renewal risk" and create CS-1427 for follow-up. Closing loop unless anyone else has blockers.

Priya (CS Ops): :thumbsup:

Alex (NetEng): :+1:

Sam (Security): Closing on my side — will update if infra needs anything.

Jordan: Closing — we'll post verification log here after the Thursday call.
